United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative:
The project aims at building the resilience of societies to the impact and spread of harmful content in conflict-prone, conflict-affected, and socially polarized environments, while protecting freedom of expression and enhancing the promotion of peace through new technologies and especially social media. To achieve this the the action will:
- Strengthen the capacities of national stakeholders -civil society, academia, media, representatives of groups in situation of vulnerability and marginalization, policy makers and relevant government bodies-, and support them to develop and apply evidence-based and multistakeholder tools and mechanisms to curb the spread and impact of harmful content online, safeguarding freedom of expression and access to information.
- Strengthen the capacities of civil Society Organizations, youth, media, digital content creators, and tech companies, and support them to adopt MIL strategies and policies, and that way, increasing resilience of social media users to the impact of harmful content, and producing gender-responsive peacebuilding narratives contributing to conflict mitigation and de-escalation.
The project will be implemented in Indonesia, Iraq, Kenya, Kyrgyzstan and South Africa, while the lessons learnt of the project will be shared globally, and will inform the development of new tools, guides and other resources which can be adapted by other member States to curb the spread and impact of harmful content online and protect freedom of expression.
